writeup.who_they_serve: The company says it supports small to medium-sized businesses across many industries, with named focus sectors of healthcare, legal services, financial services, construction, manufacturing and education. It serves Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach counties in South Florida, with its service office in Boca Raton.
writeup.how_they_work: Pricing is a monthly subscription, listed on the site as starting from $100 per user per month, with a fixed-cost model. Regular service hours are Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00, with emergency out-of-hours support listed as 24/7. Onboarding begins with a consultation call, followed by a custom package design, quote, and an arranged implementation date.
writeup.what_stands_out: The company states it has 15 years of experience and lists a 99.9% guaranteed network uptime and a 30% average cost savings claim on its Miami page, along with a free IT audit valued at $2,500 for Miami-based businesses. It lists vendor partnerships with enterprise-class hardware and software providers, though the site does not name specific partners.
